name: Capital Region Farmers Market

description: A large weekly undercover market run by the Rotary Club of Hall where more than 100 stallholders sell produce and food made in the Canberra region.
caveats: The site's FAQ page still says 7.30am start while the home and 'Getting to the market' pages say 7:00am; 7:00 used. Some stallholders list certified organic but that is per-stallholder, so no tags applied.

description: A weekly Sunday market on the grounds of Canberra College with around 60 growers, farmers and makers from the Canberra region.
caveats: Free-range and grass-fed wording is the market's general description of what is on sale, not a certification of every stall. Older third-party listings give an 8am start.
